# Aeron Cluster ErgoSBE Cleanup and Egress Hardening Plan

**Created:** 2026-07-20
**Status:** In progress
**Branch:** `first_cut`

**Goal:** Make ErgoSBE the sole codec interface for the cluster client, retain only a benchmark-private sbe-tool reference subset, and correctly reassemble regular and controlled egress messages.

**Architecture:** Protocol codecs remain generated by ErgoSBE from Aeron's schemas into `OUT_DIR` and are exposed only as `codecs::{session, mark, rfq}`. Rusteron's fragment assemblers sit inside `AeronCluster`, so decoding and listeners receive complete logical messages. The reviewed [C++ client at `d67e5ac`](https://github.com/reverb-sys/aeron-cluster-client-cpp/tree/d67e5acf057825950e48401d040f1d665945a428) is an idea source; protocol behaviour follows [official Aeron 1.52.2](https://github.com/real-logic/aeron/tree/1.52.2/aeron-cluster/src/main/java/io/aeron/cluster/client).

**Tech Stack:** Rust 1.95, ErgoSBE, rusteron-client 0.2.x, Aeron 1.52.2, Criterion, Java 17 test harness.

## Public Interface Changes

- Expose only:

  ```rust
  codecs::session
  codecs::mark
  codecs::rfq
  ```

- Remove `ergo_codecs*`, `cluster_codecs*`, and `rfq_codecs` without compatibility aliases.
- Add:

  ```rust
  pub fn poll_egress_controlled<L: ControlledEgressListener>(
      &mut self,
      adapter: &mut ControlledEgressAdapter<L>,
      fragment_limit: usize,
  ) -> ClusterResult<i32>;
  ```

- Change `ControlledEgressListener` so only `on_message` returns `ControlledPollAction`; lifecycle, challenge, and admin callbacks become default no-op methods returning `()`.
- Define `ControlledPollAction::{Continue, Abort, Break, Commit}` without numeric `repr`; explicitly map them to Aeron C values `4`, `1`, `2`, and `3`.

## Implementation Tasks

### 1. Persist the approved design and handoff

- Save this plan verbatim to `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-20-aeron-cluster-ergosbe-cleanup-and-egress-hardening.md`.
- Create `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-20-aeron-cluster-client-hardening-design.md` containing:
  - codec ownership and module seams;
  - regular/controlled egress flow;
  - the C++ adoption/rejection matrix;
  - public interface changes and compatibility policy;
  - failure handling and acceptance criteria.
- Add the work as open items in `docs/LIVING_BACKLOG.md`; move them to the closed section only after live verification.
- Commit: `docs(cluster): plan ErgoSBE cleanup and egress hardening`.

### 2. Make ErgoSBE the sole runtime codec implementation

- Change `cluster/build.rs` to generate `session.rs`, `mark.rs`, and `rfq.rs`.
- Replace aliases in `cluster/src/codecs/mod.rs` with direct public modules named `session`, `mark`, and `rfq`.
- Delete the checked-in runtime trees:
  - `cluster/src/codecs/cluster_codecs/`
  - `cluster/src/codecs/cluster_codecs_mark/`
  - `cluster/src/codecs/rfq_codecs/`
  - `cluster/src/codecs/writer_impls.rs`
- Remove the unused `unchecked-companions` Cargo feature and its build-script branch.
- Create `cluster/benches/reference_sbe/` containing only the private sbe-tool runtime plus message header, event enum, and the five codecs used by `cluster_codec_bench`. Document generator version 1.39.0 and forbid production imports.
- Update the benchmark to use `mod reference_sbe;`; preserve all existing equal-work comparisons and the ≤1.00 gate.
- Replace RFQ cross-generator testing with the frozen 77-byte golden beginning `[69, 0, 106, 0, 101, 0, 1, 0]` and ending `[244, 1, 0, 0]`, plus ErgoSBE round-trip assertions.
- Migrate all library, sample, test, and example imports to `session`, `mark`, or `rfq`.
- Commit: `refactor(cluster): make ErgoSBE the sole runtime codec`.

### 3. Assemble and filter egress before decoding

- Store `AeronFragmentClosureAssembler` and `AeronControlledFragmentClosureAssembler` inside every connected `AeronCluster`; create them fallibly during synchronous connect and async finish.
- Route `poll_egress` through the regular assembler while retaining its current fragment-count return value.
- Add `poll_egress_controlled` using the controlled assembler and explicit Aeron action mapping.
- Filter decoded messages by the connected `cluster_session_id` before listener dispatch.
- Preserve current error ordering: complete any detected leader transition before returning the first buffered decode error.
- Recreate both assemblers after a `NewLeaderEvent`, preventing an incomplete old-image message from contaminating the new image.
- Always enable reassembly; add no configuration toggle and no new dependency.
- Commit: `fix(cluster): assemble and filter cluster egress`.

### 4. Deepen tests and examples onto the production interface

- Convert lifecycle integration tests and the auction/failover examples from manual SessionConnectRequest encoding to `SessionBuilder` and `AeronCluster`.
- Use `try_claim` for application payload examples; direct codec tests remain only where codec behaviour itself is under test.
- Rewrite property tests with ErgoSBE encoders/decoders and retain arbitrary-input no-panic coverage.
- Add `cluster/tests/egress_fragmentation.rs`, gated by `test-harness`:
  - configure UDP egress with `mtu=1408`;
  - send a deterministic 16 KiB payload through the Java Echo service;
  - verify regular polling delivers exactly one complete, byte-identical message;
  - verify controlled polling does the same and honours `Commit`;
  - verify a different cluster session ID is ignored.
- Extend controlled unit tests for all four action mappings and ensure lifecycle events cannot be aborted.
- Re-run existing leader-kill tests to verify assembler resets do not regress failover.
- Commit: `test(cluster): cover ErgoSBE-only fragmented egress`.

### 5. Reconcile living and design documentation

- Update `cluster/README.md` and crate rustdoc:
  - remove the MTU/reassembly limitation;
  - explain allocation occurs only when Aeron fragments a message;
  - document `poll_egress_controlled`;
  - show only the three public codec modules;
  - identify the sbe-tool code as a Criterion-private reference.
- Update the umbrella master plan and `sbe/design/DECISIONS.md` with the rule: alternative generator output may exist only as the minimal private benchmark reference, never under cluster library source.
- Add a superseding pointer to the historical 2026-07-17 cluster design rather than rewriting its historical contents.
- Update the root README benchmark wording.
- Record in the design audit:
  - adopted: fragment assembly and lifecycle discipline;
  - already present: typed errors, validation, keep-alive, close-on-drop, leader handling;
  - rejected: custom topic/order/commit protocol, background polling threads, process-global signal handlers, automatic hot-path retries, placeholder acknowledgements, and unverified statistics.
- Close living-backlog entries with the actual command output and benchmark ratios.
- Commit: `docs(cluster): record codec ownership and egress hardening`.

## Verification

Run and record:

```bash
just check-aeron-cluster
cargo test -p ergo-aeron-cluster --doc
cargo test -p ergo-aeron-cluster --test codec_golden_bytes --test property
cargo test -p ergo-aeron-cluster --features test-harness --test egress_fragmentation -- --test-threads=1
just test-aeron-cluster-harness
just bench-cluster
git diff --check
```

The benchmark must retain every maintained ErgoSBE/sbe-tool ratio at ≤ 1.00.

Confirm no obsolete interface remains:

```bash
rg -n 'codecs::(ergo_codecs|ergo_codecs_mark|ergo_rfq_codecs|cluster_codecs|cluster_codecs_mark|rfq_codecs)|pub mod (ergo_codecs|cluster_codecs|rfq_codecs)' \
  cluster/src cluster/tests cluster/examples samples/cluster-ha-orderbook
```

Expected result: no matches. Reference sbe-tool code may occur only beneath `cluster/benches/reference_sbe/`.

## Assumptions and Non-goals

- This is an intentional clean break for the experimental `0.1.0` crate.
- Do not add an Aeron Cluster service implementation or application-specific pub/sub semantics.
- Do not remove the repository-wide `simple-binary-encoding` reference submodule or general ErgoSBE benchmarks.
- Do not add automatic retry to `offer` or `try_claim`; callers retain backpressure policy.
- Preserve unrelated worktree state, including the existing untracked `simple-binary-encoding/com/` content.
